880-6763-8293.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6763-8293.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1339-1832-5231-7286.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-5231-7286.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2169-2511-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-2511-4694-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

967-3809-6441-6495-7087.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
967-3809-6441-6495-7087.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

967-2557-3809-7087-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

728-2178-3817-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
728-2178-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5231-7452.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature, adding {R}
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1170-1594-2829-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1594-2829-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

4613-5446-7150-7940.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
4613-5446-7150-7940.description:
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
When the Cats enter, Support Mission triggers twice, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Cat.
Repeat from step 3, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

2511-4275-5003-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
2511-4275-5003-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

240-2438-5470-7296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

198-4067-6281-7252.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Grave Sifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Grave Sifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Grave Sifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4373-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4373-6968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3532-3536-5078-5240.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

4567-7074.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22 minus Greven's power.
4567-7074.description:
Activate Koh by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1496-2034-3490-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-2034-3490-4017.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more charge counters on it
with two or more loyalty counters on it

1978-2593-3301.description:
Animate Astral Cornucopia using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3234-3293-5413.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2034-3234-3293-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
2034-3234-3293-5413.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1563-2457-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1353-2744-3327-4613-5073.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1353-2744-3327-4613-5073.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you contorl.
Activate Dargo using Tinder Wall's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

2921-6014-6659.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another modified creature.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters the battlefield, Gylwain triggers, creating a Role token attached to the manifested creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3384-4550-5567-5686--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3384-4550-5567-5686--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

372-3734-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Phyrexian Metamorph.
372-3734-4681.description:
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Phyrexian Metamorph's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Phyrexian Metamorph leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Phyrexian Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

1567-6333--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the extra turn spell and Momentary Blink each turn.
There are at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
1567-6333--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Momentary Blink from your graveyard by paying its mana cost, blinking Hades and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Emet-Selch.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the extra turn spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.
1567-6333--88.notes: You must use an extra turn spell that will be put into your graveyard as it resolves, not exile or shuffling into your library.

710-2961-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding one mana of any color.
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

116-2569-2897.notablePrerequisites:
Gigantoplasm is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Gigantoplasm do not have summoning sickness.
116-2569-2897.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Gigantoplasm.
Activate Gigantoplasm by tapping it.
When Gigantoplasm becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Gigantoplasm's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

3252-4508-4875-5184.description:
Activate Shivan Hellkite by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

193-4153-4243-4554.notablePrerequisites: Aminatou has at least two loyalty counters on it.
193-4153-4243-4554.description:
Activate Venser's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, exiling any other permanent you control.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Venser.
When Venser leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least five loyalty counters on Teferi.
Activate Venser's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, exiling Aminatou.
When Aminatou leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least two loyalty counters on Teferi.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing nine loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Venser triggers twice, returning Aminatou and the other permanent exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

3317-4050-4124-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
3317-4050-4124-4772.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, attaching it to any creature you control.
Whip Silk enters the battlefield, triggering Historian's Boon's first ability, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the creature with Whip Silk attached and a Soldier token, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

215-864-2436-3014.notablePrerequisites:
Marwyn does not have summoning sickness.
Marwyn has a power of at least seven.
215-864-2436-3014.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Cast Emerald Charm by paying {G}, untapping Marwyn.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Emerald Charm from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3173-4658.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
3173-4658.description:
Cast Fling by paying {1}{R} and sacrificing Soul of Eternity, dealing damage equal to Soul of Eternity's power to target opponent with a life total equal to or less than your life total.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1000-2087-2103-2493.notablePrerequisites: {1} fewer mana required on the first turn if Mystic Reflection was foretold.
1000-2087-2103-2493.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Archaeomancer.
Cast Spore Swarm by paying {3}{G}, creating three token copies of Archaeomancer.
Each of the Archaeomancer's ETBs trigger, returning Mystic Reflection, Capture of Jingzhou, and Spore Swarm to your hand.
Repeat.

364-1309-1987-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
